fact: In August 2024 President Nyusi laid the first stone of a building at the PRM command in Maputo to house the Ministry of the Interior's new public security management information system, with US$11 million invested so far financed by the Korean Import and Export Bank, buildings planned in Maputo and Nampula provinces, and construction to last 16 months, until December 2025.
title: Mozambique to have a public security management information system - Watch
